caption:
Men with discipline and a self improvement mindset know the hardest skill is not starting. It is staying.

You've had good ideas. More than one. You left them. Every single one.

There was a man who stood in front of the greatest inventor of his era and refused to move until the deal was done. He had nothing. No track record. No money. Just one idea and a refusal to quit.

That is the difference between men who build and men who scroll.

You already know which one you've been.

Send this to a man who needs it today.
